tara (sec): We want to strip setuid binaries and drop CAP_NET_ADMIN/CAP_SYS_ADMIN from base images. Need checklist: discovery, KMS signing/IAM, audit log config, admission policy rollout, rollback plan. Quick take?
omar (infra): I'll run discovery across clusters. Will report pods with added caps, hostNetwork/hostPID, and a suid file inventory. Can run DaemonSet scanner in staging first.
hannah (eng-runtime): Kubectl jsonpath for caps and initContainers: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add} {.spec.initContainers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}
{end}' | grep -v "<none>"` Also suggest we record owners for each match.
diego (platform): For signing: recommend per-team KMS keys, grant only cryptoKeySigner, enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs, and use Workload Identity for builders. I'll draft TF module and IAM snippet.
tara (sec): Agree per-team keys. Add key-versioning policy: rotate quarterly or post-major-rebase and run an automated re-sign job for images. Also require signing events to include image name + digest + builder SA in logs.
omar (infra): Will check Data Access logging and enable it for new keys. Inventory ETA: EOD.
hannah (eng-runtime): Rollout plan: 1) inventory + owner notif 2) Gatekeeper audit-mode for 2w 3) rebuild + sign canary images 4) switch to deny with escape namespace for measured rollbacks.
diego (platform): I'll open PR for TF + logging sink; tara please review.
runbook-bot: Created ticket SEC-900 assigned to omar (infra), due 2024-10-29.
tara (sec): Thanks — action items noted. If scans find >3 affected production services, pause and do manual mitigation.
